purpose: Teach: 非合法/謀略/疎外/破裂/充満/退学/単発/創世

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、非合法な活動を行った組織の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on research into organizations that engaged in illegal activities, didn't you?
lines.style: Measured, slightly pedagogical. Patient pause before the question. Warm but formal—the register of a teacher genuinely curious about a student's work. Even tone, no edge.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、政治的謀略の歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I focused on the history of political conspiracies.
lines.style: Quiet and direct. No apology in the voice. Straightforward delivery, steady eye contact implied. A student answering honestly without overthinking.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、社会的に疎外された人々の心理を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, and you also covered the psychology of socially marginalized people in your research, didn't you?
lines.style: Gentle reframing, almost conversational. Slightly slower pace. The tone of someone connecting threads—inviting him to see what she's noticing. Warm, not accusatory.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、配管が破裂した事故の調査を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I looked into an investigation of a pipe rupture accident.
lines.style: Even tone, matter-of-fact. No hesitation. Delivered as simply as the first answer, without defensive shifts. Direct and clear.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 煙が充満した火災現場の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you wrote about research from a fire scene filled with smoke.
lines.style: Slightly more present now. Gentle lean forward. Still kind, but the pace steadies—she's becoming more engaged with what she's uncovering. Warm and curious.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、退学者の社会復帰研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I studied social reintegration research focused on people who dropped out of school.
lines.style: Calm, unshaken. Same steady delivery as before. No acceleration or defensive tone. A student remaining grounded in his answers.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、単発の事件と連続事件の比較を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you also examined comparisons between single incidents and serial incidents in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Slower now, more deliberate. A teacher pausing to let the weight of what she's seeing settle. Warm still, but with quiet significance underneath. The questions are becoming anchors.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、創世神話の比較研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—my final paper was a comparative study of creation myths.
lines.style: Steady exhale. The final answer, delivered with the same composure as the rest. Quiet finality. A student closing without defensiveness, almost peaceful in his directness.
